config.scope: Exploratory single-seed pilot, not a replicated finding. Two fresh low-label SSL baselines (20x383 steps), then 12 fixed-step continuations: 3 starts x 2 losses x 2 structures. All training starts with only 50 labels/class; no fully supervised teacher/pretraining. Reuse sibling's exact weak/strong views and epoch-lagged soft pseudo-target loss, not a full FixMatch/SoftMatch reproduction. Reserve 1000 previously unlabeled images for compression fit/check, never weight training: U=47500 rather than sibling's 48500. No test inference. Repair optimizers and sampler streams restart equally; soft SSL inherits parent confidence statistics. CE control sees identical L/U views and joint train-mode BN with no pseudo-label loss, so it is not a pure labeled-only baseline. No additional contrastive/triplet/EMA objectives. Decide the paper's scope/title only after inspecting all pilot outcomes; no communication to Marcus is sent.
